originalTitle: Stocks slip as investors eye Mideast talks, earnings
summary: STORY: Stocks fell Thursday, pausing after a strong start to the week. The Dow dropped close to one percent. The S&P 500 slid about two tenths and the Nasdaq was basically flat. Investors digested the latest round of corporate earnings and looked for signs of progress toward a peace deal between the U.S. and Iran. Strong corporate results so far have tempered some concerns about the massive spending by AI-related companies. Ben McMillan, chief investment officer with IDX Advisors, says AI will likely continue to push stocks higher though investors have broadened their view of who is likely to benefit from the growth of the technology. “So I think the AI trade broadly is still very much intact. I do think investors, and we're hearing this from our investors and others that we talked to, are going to be a little bit more discerning, they're going to be more judicious, they're going to start looking at maybe much more the picks and shovels plays we're hearing a lot more interest in things like you know uranium and power providers as you know an AI play as well as things like photonic stocks and you know not necessarily just betting on you know chips or semiconductors.” Stocks on the move included data storage company Western Digital which tumbled 13% and memory chip maker Sandisk which dropped nearly seven percent in the wake of quarterly results. Both companies have surged this year, however, with Sandisk up more than 400% and Western Digital up about 160%. And SpaceX erased losses from earlier in the session and closed six percent higher, defying expectations that shares would be pressured by insider selling, as the lockup period for early investors holding the stock expired. On the data front, the number of Americans filing claims for unemployment benefits increased slightly last week. The report came ahead of closely watched nonfarm payrolls figures for July due on Friday, which will shape expectations for the Fed's path of interest rates at a time when Chairman Kevin Warsh has scaled back on forward guidance from the central bank.

chineseTitle: 投资者关注中东谈判和财报，股市下跌
chineseSummary: 故事：周四股市下跌，在本周开局强劲后暂停。道指下跌近百分之一。标准普尔 500 指数下跌约十分之二，纳斯达克指数基本持平。投资者消化了最新一轮的企业财报，并寻找美国和伊朗之间和平协议取得进展的迹象。迄今为止，强劲的企业业绩缓解了人们对人工智能相关公司巨额支出的担忧。 IDX Advisors 首席投资官 Ben McMillan 表示，尽管投资者已经扩大了对谁可能从该技术的增长中受益的看法，但人工智能可能会继续推高股市。 “所以我认为人工智能行业总体上仍然完好无损。我确实认为投资者，我们从我们的投资者和其他与我们交谈过的人那里听到这一点，将会更加敏锐，他们会更加明智，他们将开始更多地关注镐和铲子游戏，我们听到人们对像你知道铀和电力供应商这样的事情更加感兴趣，就像你知道人工智能游戏以及光子股票这样的事情一样，你知道不一定只是赌你懂芯片或半导体。”数据存储公司西部数据 (Western Digital) 股价下跌 13%，存储芯片制造商 Sandisk 股价在季度业绩公布后下跌近 7%。然而，两家公司今年股价均大幅上涨，Sandisk 股价上涨超过 400%，Western Digital 股价上涨约 160%。 SpaceX 消除了盘中早些时候的跌幅，收盘上涨 6%，这违背了由于持有该股票的早期投资者的禁售期到期，该公司股价将受到内幕抛售压力的预期。数据方面，美国初请失业金人数小幅增长
